visible_item.prompt: Tom began washing the car at 9:00. At 10:00, he stopped because it started to rain. Complete the sentence using “wash the car”: Before it started to rain, Tom _______________.
visible_item.target_answer: Before it started to rain, Tom had been washing the car.
accepted_answers: Before it started to rain, Tom had been washing the car.
